svg.title: Chunks travel, corpora don't
svg.text: A cross-corpus query, custody preserved end to end. Here the corpus stays on one machine — because it’s set that way.
a peer you trust — hosts the corpus
Custody is your choice: this corpus keeps mesh_sharing = false, so its bytes never leave.
Set it true and the same corpus can live on several machines you trust — replicated on purpose, never behind your back.
